topic: Why matching their first $20 of earnings changes everything
caption:
The moment your teen earns their first $20 is bigger than it sounds.

Match it. Every dollar they earn, you add one. That $40 hits different than any allowance ever did.

It turns a small win into a reason to keep going — and that momentum is hard to stop.
